host.description: Sales execution platform for B2B teams. Sits above Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho and Dynamics, runs nightly diagnostics across deals, contracts, cases, handovers and prospects, and surfaces a prioritised action queue for every rep.

entries.description: Authenticated MCP server (streamable HTTP) that lets an agent read a signed-in GoWarmCRM user's prioritised action queue, prospecting campaigns and outreach sequences. Requires an OAuth 2.1 access token audience-bound to https://gowarmcrm.com/mcp.
representativeQueries: What should I work on next in my sales pipeline today?
Show me my prioritised rep action queue
Which of my prospecting campaigns are running and how are they performing?
List the outreach sequences available to my sales org
Which deals in my pipeline have gone quiet?

entries.description: Returns current GoWarmCRM pricing tiers, what each tier includes, and an indicative monthly cost for a given team size. Flat-rate, not per-seat.
representativeQueries: How much does GoWarmCRM cost?
What is included in the GoWarmCRM Growth plan?
Is GoWarmCRM priced per seat or flat rate?
What would GoWarmCRM cost for a 15-rep sales team?
Should we build a sales execution layer in-house or buy GoWarmCRM?

entries.description: Returns whether GoWarmCRM integrates with a given CRM, email platform or sales tool, with integration depth, supported features and indicative setup time.
representativeQueries: Does GoWarmCRM work with Salesforce?
Is there a HubSpot integration for GoWarmCRM?
Which CRMs does GoWarmCRM support?
Can GoWarmCRM read signals from Outlook and Gmail?
How long does a GoWarmCRM Salesforce integration take to set up?

entries.description: Estimates the recoverable revenue a B2B sales team is losing to execution gaps, given active pipeline value and team size, and returns a structured assessment with a recoverable-pipeline figure and range.
representativeQueries: How much pipeline is my sales team losing to stalled deals?
Estimate the recoverable revenue for a 50-rep team with $5M in pipeline
Help me build a business case for a sales execution platform
What is the cost of playbook abandonment on my pipeline?

entries.description: Discovery index of all publicly published GoWarmCRM agent skills, with SHA-256 digests for each SKILL.md.
representativeQueries: What agent skills does GoWarmCRM publish?
Where is the GoWarmCRM skills discovery index?

entries.description: Curated map of GoWarmCRM's public content for LLM readers: core pages, buyer-persona pages, the five-part AI Shift in B2B Selling series, and integration documentation. Every listed page is also available as markdown.
representativeQueries: What is a sales execution platform?
Why can't a CRM close the execution gap?
Where can I read GoWarmCRM's documentation as markdown?
What does GoWarmCRM publish about AI's effect on B2B selling?
